results.title: Drop Stack of Paper-whoomp.wav
results.author: DAVESTALKER
results.description: This effect was created for a radio tax spot to support the line "Here's all the directions...1,000 pages of them!" (sfx: drops 1,000 pages on desk) It makes a distinct Whoomp sound when they land. Recorded on NT2-A Rode mic in a production studio.
